# 2 Related work

Transformer models (Vaswani et al., 2017) introduced self-attention; later work [4, 7-9]
scaled it to long documents, and a 2021 survey covers the field. The two datasets were
released in 2019 and 2023 [12]. Section 3.2 compares against the protocol of Eq. (4),
Figure 5 and Table 2, summarised on p. 7 of the appendix (see also pp. 11-13).
The code is archived at https://example.org/archive/2024/v2.1 and the preprint is
arXiv:1706.03762 (doi:10.48550/arXiv.1706.03762).
